userdoc.notice: On-chain registry + validator for bounded "session keys" delegated by a user.

tokenAllowance(bytes32,address).notice: Per-session per-asset allowance (decrements on each spend).

invalidateNonceBySig(bytes32,uint256,uin.notice: Invalidate a session nonce without revoking the entire session.

validateAndConsume(address,uint256,(byte.notice: Validate a delegate-signed call and consume one session nonce.

devdoc.title: SessionManager

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

devdoc.details: - User creates a session for a delegate key (EOA or ERC-1271 wallet) with expiry and/or max-call limit. - Delegate signs per-call intents (EIP-712) that are consumed by trusted target contracts (e.g. MintAndRedeem). - Allowlisted target contracts call `validateAndConsume` to enforce session constraints, per-asset spend limits,   and replay protection (sequential nonces).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

params.nonce: The current nonce to invalidate (must match on-chain nonce).
params.executor: The address authorized to submit this invalidation (must be msg.sender).
params.sessionId: The session to invalidate the nonce for.
params.delegateSignature: EIP-712 signature from the session delegate.

params.call: Session call intent signed by the delegate.
params.executor: The relayer/bundler address that submitted the target tx (target should pass `msg.sender`).
params.spendToken: Token being spent from the session owner (0 if none).
params.delegateSignature: Signature from the session delegate over `call`.

validateAndConsume(address,uint256,(byte.details: Can only be called by the target contract that will execute the action.

tokenAllowance.details: `type(uint256).max` matches ERC-20 allowance semantics: no decrement ("infinite" allowance).
